title_en: Galen 1500mm Digging Bucket for 20-25 ton excavators
desc_en: Heavy-duty digging bucket manufactured from Hardox 450 wear plate. CAT-style tooth system. Suitable for general excavation, trenching and loading operations. Made in Turkiye.
title_tr: Galen 1500mm Kazi Kovasi - 20-25 ton ekskavatorler icin
desc_tr: Hardox 450 asinma plakasindan uretilmis agir hizmet tipi kazi kovasi. CAT tipi dis sistemi. Genel kazi, kanal acma ve yukleme operasyonlari icin uygundur.
